check_unextracted_tip: Checks apps that have neither a decrypted nor an original IPA in the output folders yet (using the current file name settings).
hint: Tip: click ☐ or double-click a row to check it; Shift-click ☐ to check a range. Select rows with Ctrl/Shift, then press Space or right-click to check them. Click the ☐ header to check every shown app.
d_app: Name: {name}    Bundle ID: {bundle}    Version: {version}    Build: {build}    PID: {pid}
d_enc_yes: Yes (original IPAs keep the executable encrypted)
d_offloaded: Offloaded: only a placeholder remains on the device, so this app cannot be extracted. Reinstall it from the App Store first.
extract_tip: Packs the installed app as-is (executables stay encrypted); needs SSH only. For apps that can't launch or crash, so they can't be decrypted. Installs on devices using the same Apple ID or with AppSync.
dump_tip: Makes an IPA whose executables are decrypted; installs on other devices after re-signing, or with AppSync on jailbroken ones. Needs frida-server on the device. The decryption mode is set in Settings → Decryption.
err_preflight: App can't launch (failed preflight checks; licence may be invalid, re-download it)
err_closed: Frida connection closed (app may have crashed or blocks Frida)
err_session: App exited right after launch (crash or anti-debugging)
err_resume: Frida could not start the app (unlock the device and keep the screen on)
err_path: Local file error (antivirus may have blocked a file)
conn_ssh_tip: Reach the device over the network with its IP address, on Wi-Fi, a LAN or a VPN. Needs nothing on the computer.
conn_usb_tip: Reach the device through the USB cable: no IP address or Wi-Fi, and usually faster and steadier. Needs usbmuxd on the computer (Windows: iTunes or the Apple Devices app; Linux: the usbmuxd package). Unlock the device and tap Trust if it asks. The device still runs its SSH server.
usb_hint_win: Install iTunes or the Apple Devices app: they provide the Apple Mobile Device Service.
usb_hint_mac: macOS provides usbmuxd; reconnect the device.
usb_hint_linux: Install the usbmuxd package (for example "sudo apt install usbmuxd") and reconnect the device.
usb_err_absent_none: No USB device {serial}: none is attached.
usb_err_none: No device on USB. Connect it with a cable, unlock it and tap Trust if it asks.
usb_err_several: Several devices on USB ({devices}): choose one.
usb_err_port: Cannot connect to port {port} over USB: {reason}.
usb_reason_noport: nothing listens on port {port} of the device (is SSH running?)
connection_help: How the computer reaches the device. The tool talks SSH either way: over the network with the device's IP, or through the USB cable (Windows needs iTunes or the Apple Devices app for this, Linux needs usbmuxd).
close_after: Close each app after decrypting it (avoids running out of memory in large batches)
separate_dirs: Keep decrypted and original IPAs in separate folders
name_help: "Type" for decrypted IPAs follows the check of every executable: decrypted, partial-decrypted-<architectures> (the main executable's decrypted architectures, e.g. partial-decrypted-armv7 or partial-decrypted-armv6-armv7) or partial-decrypted; for original IPAs it is encrypted (original if the executable was never encrypted). Leave out .ipa; an empty version becomes unknown.
name_empty: the file name cannot be empty
restart_frida: Restart frida-server and retry on Frida errors
log_ready: Ready. Enter the device IP, SSH account and password, then click Connect.
log_ready_usb: Ready. Choose the USB device, enter the SSH account and password, then click Connect.
log_loaded: {total} apps ({user} user apps); reading signature details…
log_sftp_failed: Could not open SFTP for signature details: {error}
log_frida_skipped: No valid frida-ios-dump folder, so Frida is not connected (original IPAs still work).
log_no_server: Install frida-server on the device (add https://build.frida.re in Sileo/Cydia) and make sure it is running.
log_minor: Note: frida patch versions differ ({local} vs {device}); if extraction fails, open Settings → Decryption and click "Install Frida dependencies".
log_frida_ok: Frida connected through SSH tunnel (local 127.0.0.1:{local} → device {remote}).
log_start: Extracting {n} decrypted IPA(s). Keep the device unlocked with the screen on.
log_ssh_legacy: This device only offers an old SSH host key (ssh-rsa); allowing it and trying again…
log_ssh_retry: SSH connection failed ({error}); trying once more…
log_batch_ssh_lost: SSH connection lost: the batch stopped, {n} app(s) not processed. Reconnect and select them again.
log_conn_lost_partial: [{bundle}] SSH connection was lost while decrypting: files still encrypted are due to the lost connection, not the device. Reconnect and extract this app again.
log_relaunch: [{bundle}] already running (PID {pid}); closing it so it starts fresh. Frida often cannot attach to a suspended background app.
log_finished: Decrypted IPAs finished: {ok} / {total} succeeded. Output folder: {dir}
log_extract_finished: Original IPAs finished: {ok} / {total} succeeded. Output folder: {dir}
log_download_done: frida-ios-dump downloaded; Frida dependencies still need installing.
m_ports: SSH port and Frida port must be numbers.
m_user: Enter the SSH account: usually root on rootful jailbreaks (unc0ver, checkra1n) and mobile on rootless ones (Dopamine, palera1n rootless).
m_none: Check one or more apps in the list.
m_name:
{kind} file name is invalid: {error}

Fix it in Settings → Output.
m_dup:
These apps would get the same file name. Add a field such as Bundle ID to the file name in Settings → Output:

{files}
m_busy: Cancel or wait for the extraction to finish before disconnecting.
m_close: An extraction is still running. Close and abort it?
m_cancel: Cancel now? The app currently being processed will be aborted.
m_paused:
{n} apps in a row failed with Frida connection errors, so the batch was paused.

Reboot (or respring) the device, then click "Check failed apps" and try again.
m_dump_old_frida:
frida-ios-dump mode needs frida 16 or later, but this device uses frida {version}.

Choose Direct decryption mode in Settings → Decryption.
m_no_dump_dir: The frida-ios-dump folder is not set, so decrypted IPAs cannot be extracted. Set it, or click "Install frida-ios-dump", in Settings → Decryption.
m_dump_dir_busy:
This folder exists and is not empty, so it cannot be downloaded here. Click "Install frida-ios-dump" in Settings → Decryption to choose another location:

{path}
inst_device_no_ssh: Same as device frida-server (SSH not connected, version unknown)
inst_device_missing: Same as device frida-server (frida-server is not installed on the device)
inst_fetch_failed: Could not get the version list from PyPI: {error}
log_frida_versions: Device frida-server: {device} ({state}); frida versions on this computer: {local}
log_frida_missing: No frida {major}.x is installed on this computer, which device frida-server {device} needs.
inst_installed: frida versions on this computer (the one matching each device is picked automatically):
inst_reinstall: This version is already installed; installing it again replaces it.
inst_other_major: Note: its major version differs from device frida-server {device}, so it will only be used with other devices.
inst_will_run: These commands will run on this computer (frida goes into its own folder under {path}; npm install needs Node.js):
log_verify_ok: [{bundle}] Verified: all {n} Mach-O files are decrypted.
log_verify_partial: [{bundle}] Verified: {n} of {total} Mach-O files are still encrypted ({status}):
check_partial_tip: Check apps whose decrypted IPA still has encrypted files: verified in this session, or found in the output folder under a partial-decrypted-… file name (needs {{type}} in the file name).
log_rename_failed: Could not rename the IPA to {path}: {error}
log_partial_summary: {n} IPA(s) are only partially decrypted; "Check partially decrypted apps" selects them.
reason_slice32: 32-bit slice; this device runs only the 64-bit slice, so it was never decrypted
reason_watch: Watch app; it does not run on this device
reason_appex: app extension; it runs in its own process, which frida-ios-dump does not decrypt
reason_framework: framework/library the app had not loaded yet
reason_other: not loaded by the app while it was dumped
d_verify_ok: Decryption check: all {n} Mach-O files are decrypted
d_verify_partial32: Decryption check: {n} of {total} Mach-O files still have encrypted 32-bit slices (all 64-bit code is decrypted)
d_verify_partial: Decryption check: {n} of {total} Mach-O files are still encrypted
repair_tip: After each decrypted IPA, files that are still encrypted (app extensions, frameworks the app had not loaded, 32-bit slices) are decrypted on the device and patched into the IPA. iOS 15 and earlier decrypt any of them; iOS 16 and later app extensions and frameworks (for frameworks the app is let start without its UI, so its initialization code runs). The app on the device must be the same version as the IPA.
stage_repair: decrypting {n} remaining file(s) on the device
log_repair_start: [{bundle}] Decrypting {n} still-encrypted file(s) on the device…
log_repair_done: [{bundle}] Decrypted on the device: {n} of {total} file(s).
log_repair_failed: [{bundle}] Could not decrypt the remaining files on the device: {error}
reason_repair_missing: not found in the app on the device ({error})
reason_repair_mismatch: the file on the device differs from the one in the IPA, so the installed app is another version (sizes {error})
reason_repair_oldslice: this is the slice for an older CPU, which this device never runs; the slice it runs was decrypted, so the app still works here ({error})
reason_repair_nomem: the device refused to decrypt it ({error})
reason_repair_nokey: the device has no key for it; usually the app was not installed with this device's Apple ID, e.g. from an already decrypted or re-signed IPA ({error})
reason_repair_frida: could not attach to the app with Frida ({error})
dump_method_frida_direct: Direct decryption mode (iOS 16+ loads the app suspended)
dump_method_frida_ios_dump_tip: frida-ios-dump launches each app and copies its decrypted code from memory. Needs the frida-ios-dump folder. Keep the device unlocked.
dump_method_frida_direct_tip: Copies the installed app and decrypts every executable on the device without running it, so apps that crash on launch work too (except apps without a decryption key). iOS 15 and earlier: every file. iOS 16 and later: the app and its extensions (they are started suspended, and Settings is opened briefly for Safari extensions); for encrypted frameworks the app is first let start without its UI, so its initialization code runs, and they are then loaded into it; Watch apps stay encrypted. Does not need frida-ios-dump.
log_start_direct: Extracting {n} decrypted IPA(s) without running the apps.
reason_repair_unsupported_slice: this device does not load this architecture, so on iOS 16 and later it cannot be decrypted
reason_repair_unsupported_watch: Watch app code cannot be decrypted on this device on iOS 16 and later
reason_repair_unsupported_other: iOS 16 and later: only executables of the app and its extensions can be decrypted
reason_repair_unsupported_extension: no system process could start this app extension
log_repair_retry: [{bundle}] {n} file(s) failed because of frida-server; restarting it and trying again…
log_repair_run_app: [{bundle}] Letting the app start without its UI to decrypt its frameworks (this runs the app's initialization code)…
reason_repair_unsupported_minos: it requires iOS {error}, so this device never loads it and it cannot be decrypted here
decrypt_help: These settings only apply to "Extract decrypted IPA"; original IPAs need none of them. Choose how apps are decrypted: with helper programs on the device, or with Frida. "Connect" also connects Frida when the chosen mode uses it.
native_auto_tip: iOS 15 and earlier: file mapping. iOS 16 and later: process memory.
native_mremap: File mapping (mremap_decrypt; iOS 15 and earlier only)
native_mremap_tip: Asks the kernel to decrypt each file's encrypted range with mremap_encrypted(). No app is started, so apps that crash on launch work too, and every file is covered (main executable, extensions, frameworks). iOS 16 and later refuse this.
m_mremap:
File mapping works only on iOS 15 and earlier, but this device runs iOS {version}, which refuses it.

Choose Automatic or Process memory instead.
m_helper:
The helper program for native decryption could not be used.

{error}
native_memory_tip: Starts the app the way the system does, suspended, and reads the decrypted code from its memory, then lets it run for a moment so its frameworks load (the app's initialization code runs) and reads those too. App extensions are started stopped right after exec and read the same way; frameworks the app did not link are loaded with dlopen. Works on iOS 16 and later.
log_start_native: Extracting {n} decrypted IPA(s) with the native helper.
reason_repair_helper: the helper could not run or failed ({error})
family_native_tip: Copies the installed app and decrypts its executables with two small helper programs that run on the device. Neither frida-server nor frida-ios-dump is needed. The tool checks the helpers' checksum and puts them on the device over SSH (as root, or as mobile with sudo). Needs a jailbreak that accepts ad-hoc signed programs; arm64 devices only (32-bit slices stay encrypted). Choose the helper below, or leave it on Automatic.
family_frida_tip: Decrypts with Frida: needs frida-server on the device and a matching frida on the computer. Choose one of the two Frida modes below.
m_conn_switch: Switching the connection method disconnects the current device. Continue?
